biotools.summary: This package provides functionality for reading data from HDF Scalable Data Service from within R.  The HSDSArray function bridges from HSDS to the user via the DelayedArray interface.  Bioconductor manages an open HSDS instance graciously provided by John Readey of the HDF Group.
